load.description: List of log file paths or glob patterns to load at startup (e.g., ['/var/log/apache2/access.log', '/var/log/apache2/access*.gz']). Supports gzip/bzip2 compressed files.

execute.description: Single SQL query to execute, then exit. If omitted, starts an interactive shell.

input_file.description: Read commands from this file instead of starting an interactive session.
